module_summary: HDLC bit-stream recognizer: Moore FSM counting consecutive ones in one state register, decoding disc, flag and err outputs from terminal states.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Ten-state ones-run controller register; outputs decoded from SDISC/SFLAG/SERR.

anchors.name: disc
anchors.why: Asserted in SDISC: stuffed zero after five ones must be discarded.

anchors.name: flag
anchors.why: Asserted in SFLAG: six-ones frame boundary detected.

anchors.name: err
anchors.why: Asserted in SERR: seven or more consecutive ones.

groups.name: Sequence controller
groups.description: Single-always FSM tracking run of ones on serial input.

groups.name: Output decode
groups.description: Moore outputs decoded from terminal states.
